applies_to: ConceptCardV1. These are ad concepts for a paid recovery play, not email or SMS creative.

warm_vs_cold.setup: Cut it. A past buyer needs no problem education and no brand introduction.
warm_vs_cold.message_pivot: From emotional agitation to value stacking, price anchors and risk reversal.
warm_vs_cold.hook_type: Direct retargeting hook that acknowledges the relationship, not a self-selection hook.

founder_customer_call.shape: Split-screen video, founder calling a past customer to thank them.
founder_customer_call.why: Raw and native to feed; triggers nostalgia and social proof.

apology_restock.shape: Text-heavy high-contrast static apologising for going out of stock.
apology_restock.proof_device: Demand itself. Selling out repeatedly is the proof.
apology_restock.why: Humility plus FOMO on a real restock.
apology_restock.requires: a real stock or availability event
apology_restock.guard: Must not be emitted without one. Fabricated scarcity violates the honest-urgency rule in round 1 Q9, and its discount is only valid because it is bound to a real event.

variant_grid.why: Shifts the decision from yes-or-no to which-one.

founders_letter.shape: Text-only static that looks like a screenshot of a personal letter.
founders_letter.why: Bypasses commercial defenses by not looking like an ad.
founders_letter.note: Same principle as the plain-text first-touch email in the message rules.

use_case_expansion.shape: The product in new relatable micro-moments.
use_case_expansion.why: They churned from habit loss, not dislike. A fresh use case restarts the habit.

kit_boundary: The kit produces the concept only: tension, big idea, hook, opening visual, proof device, format, CTA, pile fit, production requirements. It does not produce creative assets.
